Marcus / Vanessa — legal has reviewed the redline and the attached logo guidelines (cloudpark-logo-guidelines.pdf). We can approve the case study and logo use with the following conditions:

1) Use the provided full-color horizontal logo only; do not alter proportions or colors.
2) Maintain a minimum clearspace equal to the height of the logo mark (see guidelines).
3) Do not place logo on background colors that materially change contrast — use reversed white only when on a dark field and only with our approval.
4) The quote attributed to Tom Huang is approved as-is.
5) Any future use beyond the case study (e.g., paid ads, co-branded events) requires separate written permission.

Please confirm acceptance of those conditions so we can move forward. We consider this approval for the current case study copy only; DocuSign signature is not required for this use, but we have provided a DocuSign link if Redwood prefers formal signature: https://app.docusign.com/doc/ABC123XYZ

Regards,
Patricia Cole
General Counsel
CloudPark, Inc.
legal@cloudpark.io
